title: Ottawa Treaty opened for signature
summary: The Convention banning anti-personnel mines was concluded at Oslo on 18 September 1997 and opened for signature at Ottawa on 3 December 1997. States undertook never to use, produce, stockpile or transfer such mines and to destroy existing ones. It entered into force on 1 March 1999.

as_recorded.value: opened for signature at Ottawa, Canada, by all States from 3 December 1997

where.modern_name: Ottawa, Canada (proxy pin: Ottawa, the location Wikidata lists)

importance.justification: Landmark multilateral disarmament treaty banning a whole class of weapons, with 162 parties per the UN record.
